title: Link Collection
prompt: Create links to a local page, an external URL, an email address, and a section on the same page.
objective: Add four clearly labeled links and a matching id for the fragment.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: absolute urls, relative paths, fragments.
hints: Use relative paths for sibling pages, a complete https URL for an external destination, mailto: for email, and a fragment id for same-page navigation.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Use relative paths for sibling pages, a complete https URL for an external destination, mailto: for email, and a fragment id for same-page navigation. Required structural evidence: href="about.html", https://, mailto:, #contact.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
